messages:
zoe.docs: FYI: small but breaking change incoming to SDK config parsing - we will start rejecting unknown top-level keys and require `routes` as the canonical config entry. A short migration guide is up: https://redwood.inference/internal/docs/config-enforcement :wave:

mike.sdk: Can you confirm the rollout window? We need to schedule warning releases.

zoe.docs: Beta opt-in 2026-03-28, soft warnings in SDKs start 2026-04-04, hard rejection enforced 2026-04-18.

carla.eng: Which SDKs get the soft warnings? Node/Py first?

zoe.docs: Node >=4.x and Python >=3.2 will have the full warning->error shim for two releases. Go and Rust will get a warning-only release first, then enforcement.

sam.product: For Dedicated/Private customers can we offer a short opt-out?

zoe.docs: Yes  `REDWOOD_CONFIG_STRICT=false` env var preserves legacy behavior for approved customers until 2026-05-01. Have Support send exceptions to customers@redwood.com with subject "Config enforcement exception".

mike.sdk: I'll add console warnings and a link to the migration snippet. Example we should show in docs?

zoe.docs: Added snippet in the guide (old vs new canonical). Also adding a small `config-lint` helper to docs repo.

infra-bot: created doc page: /internal/docs/config-enforcement (scheduled public publish 2026-03-30) :rocket:

carla.eng: I'll run a quick grep across infra repos for top-level keys and share results here by EOD.

zoe.docs: Perfect  thanks everyone.
